The University of Michigan’s preliminary read on consumer sentiment for October showed its closely watched index falling to 46.3 from 48.1 last month.

Consumers are wrangling with a high cost-of-living environment where inflation continues to run above normal and gas prices have soared higher in recent months as a result of the war in Iran. In September, borrowing got even more expensive when the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in three years.
